assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, stranded, PE, HiSeq 4000) of isolated cardiac myocytes (S5.7.p1)

groups.3M: WT vs Myh6-Cre:Dsp W/F (DH), regular activity, N=5 each (S6.1.p3)
groups.6M_RA: WT vs DH after 3 months regular activity, N=5 each (S6.1.p5)
groups.6M_EX: WT vs DH after 3 months daily treadmill exercise (60 min, 5.5 kJ), N=5 each (S5.5.p1, S6.4.p3, FIG2)

sample_inclusion: all 5 DH-EX mice incl. one that stopped exercising at 2.5 months with heart failure (S6.4.p3, S6.4.p6; FIG2 volcano N=5 per group)
primary_estimand: Effect of 3 months treadmill exercise on the cardiac myocyte transcriptome in WT and Dsp-haploinsufficient mice, and its restoration ('rescue') of the DH-vs-WT dysregulation (title; S6.4.p4-p6, S6.4.p11)
planned_contrasts: WT EX vs WT RA at 6M (S6.4.p4; paper 2529 DEGs, 1390 up / 1139 down)
DH EX vs DH RA at 6M (S6.4.p5; paper 2391 DEGs, 867 up / 1524 down)
genotype x exercise interaction at 6M (S6.4.p11; paper 65 genes, 19 up / 46 down)
DH vs WT at 6M RA (S6.1.p5; paper 781 DEGs, 614 up / 167 down)
DH vs WT at 3M (S6.1.p4; paper 56 DEGs, 21 up / 35 down; abstract says 57)
rescue: DH-EX vs WT not different for 492/781 genes (S6.4.p6)
paper_method: featureCounts counts; edgeR; q<0.05; RUVr normalization only for comparisons across time points (S5.7.p2)
normalization: edgeR (TMM implied); RUVr for across-time comparisons (S5.7.p2)
enrichment: GSEA v2.2.3 Hallmark + canonical pathways, q<0.05 (S5.8.p1)
